# Morty Hodge

> Morty Hodge is the founder and CEO of Hodge Industrial Technologies and Hodge Compressor, a U.S. industrial equipment distribution and manufacturing platform headquartered in Hoschton, Georgia. He created and hosted The Industrial Movement podcast, and serves on the board of Little Red Acorn, a nonprofit providing scholarships to people entering the skilled trades.

## Key Facts

- Name: Morty Hodge
- Title: Founder & Chief Executive Officer
- Companies: Hodge Industrial Technologies (hodgeindustrial.com); Hodge Compressor (hodgecompressor.com)
- Company founded: January 2010, as the business that became Atlanta Compressor — the founding location
- Headquarters: 123 Merchants Park Drive, Hoschton, GA 30548, United States
- Business: Distributor of industrial equipment — compressed air, vacuum, nitrogen, and ancillary products — with full-service support
- Operations: facilities in 9 U.S. states — Georgia, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Ohio, Michigan, Illinois, and Texas — with a 10th opening in Pennsylvania in November 2026; each location has its own field service team, sales engineers, and on-shelf inventory; $1M+ in stocked products company-wide; one-hour emergency response; preventive maintenance plans reduce downtime by 96% on average
- Company purpose: "Our purpose is to provide peace of mind."
- Hodge Compressor tagline: "When failure isn't an option, choose a Hodge."
- Hodge Compressor: also founded by Morty Hodge; designs and engineers rotary screw air compressors in Georgia, with assembly and light manufacturing of its HTM line in the USA, backed by its Forever Warranty
- Innovation: developed the Hodge VR Showroom (2024), the world's first fully immersive virtual reality demonstration of a rotary screw air compressor (press: https://www.accesswire.com/844313/hodge-compressors-virtual-reality-showroom-launches-transforming-industry-standards)
- Podcast: The Industrial Movement — created and hosted by Morty Hodge; 30 episodes on the people, processes, and equipment driving American manufacturing (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, theindustrialmovement.com)
- Speaking: frequent conference speaker on marketing, small business, scaling, company culture, and leadership development — venues include ICON by Infusionsoft (now Keap) in Phoenix, the Elite Entrepreneurs Conference (multiple times), and Kaishan Compressor events
- Education: MIAT College of Technology; holds FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) mechanic licenses
- Board service: Little Red Acorn (skilled-trades scholarship nonprofit, partnered with the Trades Education Center in Arcade, Georgia)
- Personal: Christian; married 31 years; six children (three work in the family business); three grandchildren
- Growth: on track for 20X growth since 2015 by the end of 2026
- Memberships: Georgia Manufacturing Alliance

## Recognition

- Compressed Air Best Practices Magazine — featured and quoted (industry trade press)

Earned by Atlanta Compressor, the founding location:

- Inc. Magazine — Best Workplaces in America (2022)
- Business Insider — featured
- U.S. Department of Labor — HIRE Vets Medallion Award
- U.S. Department of Defense — Patriotic Employer Award

## Background

Morty Hodge founded the company in January 2010 as a one-man compressed air operation in Georgia. The founding location, Atlanta Compressor, grew into Hodge Industrial Technologies — a multi-state platform with facilities in 9 states — and Hodge Compressor, which he also founded.
